snippet.title: Great Fox/Turret Mode for PC Port [Release + Download]
snippet.description:
You can now play all levels as the Great Fox in the Star Fox 64 PC Port! Leagues better than the original turret mode restoration I made last year. Now with new features such as a charge attack, tractor beam, tougher bosses, and new enemy behaviors.
